newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain allocates $50 mln to upgrade oil refinery.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain allocates $50 mln to upgrade oil refinery.

text.p: Bahrain has allocated $50 million to upgrade its oil refinery, Oil and Industry Minister Sheikh Isa bin Ali al-Khalifa said in remarks published on Sunday.

"There is an upgrading process for the refinery right now. In fact, an amount exceeding $50 million has been allocated for that purpose during 1997," the English-language Bahrain Tribune newspaper quoted Sheikh Isa as saying. He gave no details.
Bahrain on Monday bought a 40 percent stake held by Caltex, the Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp joint venture, in Bahrain Petroleum Company which runs the plant.
Bahrain previously held 60 percent of the refinery.

Built in 1936, the plant has a refining capacity of 250,000 barrels of oil per day. It exports petroleum products such as middle distillates to Middle East, African, Indian subcontinent and Asian markets.
